# Preface {.unnumbered}

## Reading the argument maps

Every argument map in this book comes with a full text description.

- **On the web**, the description is directly below the map, in a box
  labelled "Text description." Select it to open it. The description is a
  nested list: each claim is followed, one level in, by the inferences
  that support it, and each inference by the claims it starts from.
- **In the Word version**, each map links to its description in the
  appendix at the end of its chapter. There, each claim and inference is a
  heading, so you can explore a map using the Navigation Pane or your
  screen reader's heading navigation.

A claim marked "(Stopping Point)" has nothing further supporting it.
